title: Health Risk Assessment (Annual Wellness Visit)
about: The health risk assessment Medicare's Annual Wellness Visit starts from, with every topic 42 CFR 410.15 lists (as amended for 2026): about you, your health, how you have been feeling, habits and safety, everyday activities including balance and falls, and planning ahead, plus the providers and medicines the first visit lists. The patient fills it in before the visit, in under 20 minutes; the clinician reviews it in the visit.

source.name: Medicare Annual Wellness Visit health risk assessment, 42 CFR 410.15

blocks.text: Please fill this in before your yearly wellness visit. Your answers help you and your care team make a plan to keep you well. You can skip any question you would rather not answer.

blocks.label: In general, how is your health?
items: My health is

blocks.label: Do you have trouble with any of these?
items: Walking one block
Climbing a flight of stairs
Getting up from a chair without using your arms
Feeling weak or worn out
Losing weight without trying

blocks.label: In the past month, how often have you felt:
items: Down or sad
Stressed
Angry or easily upset
Lonely or cut off from other people
Tired, with little energy
In pain

blocks.label: Overall, how happy are you with your life?
items: I am

blocks.label: Please check one answer for each.
items: Do you smoke or use tobacco or vaping products now?
Do you drink alcohol on most days?
Do you exercise at least 30 minutes on 5 or more days a week?
Do you eat fruit or vegetables every day?
Have you seen a dentist in the past year?
Do you have trouble chewing or a sore mouth?
Do you always wear a seat belt in a car?
Do you have working smoke alarms at home?
Do you have loose rugs, clutter or poor lighting where you walk at home?
If there is a gun in your home, is it locked up?
Do you have questions or concerns about sex or your sexual health?
Do you have trouble hearing, even with hearing aids?
Do you have trouble seeing, even with glasses?

blocks.label: Do you need help from another person with:
items: Getting dressed
Eating
Grooming, such as brushing your hair or teeth
Bathing or showering
Using the toilet
Getting in and out of bed or a chair
Walking

blocks.label: Do you need help from another person with:
items: Shopping
Making meals
Using the phone
Housework
Laundry
Getting to places you need to go
Taking your medicines the right way
Paying bills and handling money

blocks.label: Please check one answer for each.
items: Do you feel unsteady or worry about falling when you walk?
Have you fallen in the past year?

blocks.label: How do you usually get to places you need to go? (tick all that apply)
items: I drive
Family or friends drive me
Bus or other public transport
A van or ride service
I walk

blocks.label: Other doctors, therapists, home health agencies or medical equipment suppliers you use
Medicines you take, including vitamins, calcium and other supplements
Have you written down the care you would want if you could not speak for yourself? (tick all that apply)
items: Yes, I have an advance directive or living will
Yes, I have named someone to make health care decisions for me
No, not yet
I would like to talk about this at my visit

fields.label: One health goal I have for this year

blocks.label: Anything else you want to talk about at your visit
Reviewed at the visit
items: Depression risk, with a screening tool
Functional ability and safety: hearing, everyday activities, fall risk and home safety
Cognitive function, by direct observation, with what the patient, family and others report
Substance use risk, with referral if needed; opioid prescriptions reviewed
Screening schedule for the next 5 to 10 years, and risk factors listed
Advance care planning offered, if the patient wishes
